item.title: Red-hot Red Raiders surge into the AP Top 10
item.description: Off the heels of a three-game winning streak, Texas Tech men's basketball jumped six spots to No. 10 in the latest AP Top 25 poll.

item.title: Austin Police names 2nd victim killed in West 6th Street mass shooting
item.description: Austin Police held a press conference Monday afternoon about the Sunday morning mass shooting on West Sixth Street that left three people dead, including the shooter, and 14 others injured.

item.title: Texas Tech baseball player arrested for DWI
item.description: Texas Tech freshman pitcher and outfielder Jesse Rusinek was arrested and booked into Lubbock County Detention Center Monday on a charge of Driving While Intoxicated - Open Alcohol Container.

item.title: Texas Tech students educate public on beef at San Antonio Rodeo
item.description: It was more than livestock shows and rodeos down at San Antonio this year, as the Davis College of Agriculture aimed at helping educate the public on animal protein.

item.title: Lubbock resident searching for rehomed service dog
item.description: A service dog named 'Moxxie' is being looked for by its owner, Nikolai Smith after he was rehomed in December of 2025 by their former roommate without Smith's knowledge.

item.title: Former Texas Tech student killed in Austin mass shooting
item.description: Ryder Harrington, a Texas Tech student, was one of two people killed in a shooting at a Sixth Street Austin bar that left 14 others injured, and a GoFundMe has been set up to support his loved ones.

item.title: Missing 11-year-old Lubbock girl was found safe
